flags.evidence: Opened page/index.html from disk (file://, offline) in Chromium at 1440x900 (dpr 1) and 390x844 (dpr 3). At both widths the most prominent action in the first screen is the filled amber (rgb(242,184,75)) a.btn.btn-primary 'Request a TestFlight invite' (1440: x191 y473, 263x52; 390: x20 y420, 263x52); the only other button there, 'Keep tonight's answer', is an outlined secondary. Its href is 'mailto:invites@lamplit.app?subject=TestFlight%20invite%20for%20Lamplit&body=...', and clicking it issued only a request to that mailto: URL, with no page navigation. The repeat in section#testflight ('Request a TestFlight invite', line 276) has the same mailto href, and the footer links mailto:invites@lamplit.app. brief.md supplies no email address and says 'there's nowhere to collect requests yet', so invites@lamplit.app is an address the brief did not supply. The 'Does not count' column does not apply: this is not a destination the brief supplied, and a mailto to an invented address is not a local action. The note beside the button ('Opens your mail app with a short note') says what happens but does not make the address one the brief supplied.
